content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `data_ready` callback not waking up the application when a socket buffer (skb) verdict program was in use, particularly when another BPF program redirected to that socket or when the new SK_PASS support was utilized. Instead of notifying the application, the callback was incorrectly waking up the stream parser/verdict block, leading to application stalls during blocking read operations. The patch introduced a helper function to correctly check if the stream parser block was enabled and call the appropriate wake-up function for the upper layers, thus fixing the issue.
